features.label: Universal stat percentages
features.help: Equipment bonuses follow the actual formula's attributes.

features.label: Effective-HP defense bonuses
features.help: Equipment DEF/MDF bonuses divide damage by 1 + bonus.

features.label: Unhindered healing
features.help: Protections do not reduce restoration. Zombie still applies.

features.label: Additive Armor/Mental Break
features.help: Break adds 25% of the same hit's unmitigated base damage.

features.label: Consume buffs at action end
features.help: All hits benefit before consumed Auto-Crit/MP-0 expire.

features.label: Opposite-element weakness
features.help: An opposite elemental weakness grants a 1.25x multiplier.

features.label: Refresh status duration
features.help: Successful reapplication refreshes a timed status.

features.label: Enemy duration resistance
features.help: Duration resistance is separate from application chance.

features.label: Single-use Threaten
features.help: Only one successful Threaten per enemy incarnation.

features.label: Guaranteed-hit policy
features.help: Native guaranteed-hit actions preserve their hit semantics.

features.label: Quickcast
features.help: One Black Magic spell, rank 2, double MP cost.

features.label: White Magic in Double/Quickcast
features.help: Independent White Magic submenu in the active cast command.

features.label: Current-MP magic power
features.help: MAG gains floor(sqrt(MP / 2)); Focus is counted once.

features.label: Switch costs a turn
features.help: A voluntary switch pays the selected CTB action rank.

features.label: Auto-reinforce Eject/Shatter
features.help: First native-eligible reserve replaces an ejected ally.

features.label: Single/multi-hit scaling
features.help: Explicit balance rates; both default to neutral100%, not an inferred rule.
